records.prompt: Create a precisely aligned sprite sheet of 12 separate hand-painted icons in exactly 4 columns and 3 rows. The image is 1536 by 1536 pixels; each cell is exactly 384 by 512 pixels. Every object must be centered in its cell, about 220 pixels wide and 240 pixels tall, separated by generous PURE WHITE empty space. No grid lines, borders, card backgrounds, captions, shadows extending between cells, or labels except the few explicitly requested simple brand monograms. Nothing crosses cell boundaries. Match the provided watercolor reference: refined illustrated storybook, traditional gouache and transparent watercolor, delicate pencil contours, pigment granulation, handmade imperfect edges, naturally muted rainbow accents, sophisticated small collectible objects, consistent optical size, compact silhouette, readable at 64px. Pure flat white #ffffff background, no overall paper texture. These are tool and UI icons, not full landscapes. Read row by row, left to right. Cell 1: two intertwined blue and warm yellow snakes, Python emblem; Cell 2: red-orange open circular flame ring with small dot, PyTorch emblem; Cell 3: folded blue-to-amber mathematical wave surface, MATLAB; Cell 4: three pale teal wind turbines with flowing wind; Cell 5: open ivory manuscript, fountain pen and a mathematical integral; Cell 6: one blue enamel hexagon with a simple letter C; Cell 7: blue hexagon with clear C++ sign; Cell 8: blue square pigment tile with a clear TS monogram; Cell 9: black wireframe tetrahedron with subtle blue shading; Cell 10: friendly blue whale carrying small coloured shipping containers; Cell 11: coral tilted square with three connected branching nodes; Cell 12: turquoise leaping dolphin above a small database cylinder. Keep every icon fully inside its own centered cell.
